newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Romania to join CEFTA in July, Slovenia says.
newsitem.headline: Romania to join CEFTA in July, Slovenia says.

text.p: Romania will sign the Central European Free Trade Agreement (CEFTA) on Saturday and become a member of the bloc in July, CEFTA president Slovenia said on Wednesday.

"The agreement will be signed at the meeting of economic ministers of the CEFTA countries in Bucharest on Saturday," Vojka Ravbar, Slovenian state secretary for international economic relations, told a news conference.
Slovenia has held the rotating presidency of CEFTA, which also includes the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland and Slovakia, since January.
Romania will be the first country to join CEFTA since January 1996 when Slovenia became a member.
Ravbar said Bulgaria was most likely to follow Romania in extending the free-trade area. She said negotiations between CEFTA and Bulgaria would start this month and could be finished this year.
Latvia, Lithuania, Estonia, Macedonia and Ukraine had also said they would like to join CEFTA in the future. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
